# What would each pricing plan earn from your actual customers?

> Free usage-based pricing simulator. Compare up to three metered plans (platform fee, included units, overage price, volume tier) against your customer usage distribution and see revenue, margin, bill shock, customers below cost, revenue if customers pick their cheapest plan, and revenue as usage grows.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
